description: This file provides utility functions to build chart data objects for visualization in a React application, specifically for a habits and tasks tracking dashboard. Functions generate data for habit completion over days, streak leaders, task throughput, and task distribution charts.

methods.name: buildHabitCompletionLast30Days
methods.description: Creates chart data for habit completion counts over the last 30 days.

methods.name: buildStreakLeaders
methods.description: Generates chart data for top 5 habits by best streak.

methods.name: buildTaskThroughput
methods.description: Builds chart data for weekly completed tasks and cumulative totals.

methods.name: buildTaskDistribution
methods.description: Produces doughnut chart data for task status and priority distributions.
